summary: Anthropic launched Claude Tag, a Slack-integrated agentic teammate that lets users delegate multi-step, asynchronous tasks to Claude across channels, tools and codebases.

mechanisms.reason: The product lets teams delegate tasks to an AI agent embedded in team chat rather than operating software themselves, and Anthropic discloses substantial internal displacement of engineering work.
mechanisms.quote: Today, 65% of our product team\u2019s code is created by our internal version of Claude Tag.

mechanisms.reason: Asynchronous, parallel, multi-turn agent usage across many channels and tasks implies a higher volume of model calls than single-chat interactions.
mechanisms.quote: we now spend much more of our time delegating tasks to many Claudes in parallel

notable_reason: The disclosed internal metric that 65% of a product team's code is now generated via this agentic Slack workflow is a concrete, quantified data point on real-world agentic displacement of engineering labor.
